ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 17
   C. 15
   D. 21

2. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 400
   D. 10

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

4. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 50
   C. 14
   D. 49

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

6. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 1
   C. 21
   D. 9

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. 2/2
   B. They are equal
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

8. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 11

9. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

10. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 170

11. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 31

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 34
   C. 66
   D. 17

13. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

14. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x = 5
   D. x > 5

15. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 30
   C. 42
   D. 90

16. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

17. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

18. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

19. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 24.5
   C. 7
   D. 49

20. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31.6
   C. 31.7
   D. 31

21. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 15.7
   D. 21

22. Solve for x: x + 8 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 8
   C. 10
   D. 18

23. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 32
   C. 33
   D. 4

24. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 9

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
